name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Implementation Project Manager | SMB SaaS Onboarding, Client Communication Software, Training
summary: Implementation lead who gets small-business customers live and confident on client communication software. At Wix I carried up to ~25 concurrent onboardings and launched 25+ clients per month at 110% of implementation targets. At Birdeye I onboarded and trained partners on reputation management and marketing automation tools, including healthcare-focused agencies, and retained all but one of 15-20 (~94%). At Solenzo I build appointment reminders, no-show recovery, and review-request workflows for service businesses, the same jobs PetDesk does for clinics.

Document every client interaction, configuration, and deliverable in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, and report progress with specific recommendations.
